sections.heading: Define the possible outcomes first
sections.body: Before computing a probability, list the outcomes that count. On a fair six-sided die the sample space is {1,2,3,4,5,6}. Events are subsets of that space.
sections.visual: On a fair six-sided die, {2, 4, 6} are even and {5, 6} are greater than four. Their intersection contains only 6, so the chance of “even and greater than four” is 1/6.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Start with the six equally likely outcomes"><title>Start with the six equally likely outcomes</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Start with the six equally likely outcomes</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="120" cy="160" r="28" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="120" y="166" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">1</text></g><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="200" cy="160" r="28" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="200" y="166" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">2</text></g><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="280" cy="160" r="28" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="280" y="166" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">3</text></g><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="360" cy="160" r="28" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="360" y="166" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">4</text></g><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="440" cy="160" r="28" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="2"/><text x="440" y="166" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">5</text></g><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="520" cy="160" r="28" fill="#172331" stroke="#ffd479" stroke-width="3"/><text x="520" y="166" fill="#ffd479" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle">6</text></g><text x="320" y="250" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">Even ∩ greater than 4 = {6} → 1/6</text><text x="320" y="290" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">Define the sample space first</text><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Fair die · equally likely faces</text></svg>

sections.heading: “And” and “or” use different rules
sections.body: Union adds probabilities and subtracts the overlap. Independent conjunction multiplies.
sections.visual: The shared part of the two sets must be counted once for “or.”
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Or counts a union. And follows a path."><title>Or counts a union. And follows a path.</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Or counts a union. And follows a path.</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="200" cy="180" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="3"/><text x="160" y="185" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="16">A</text></g><g class="lw-step"><circle cx="280" cy="180" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#7ee2a8" stroke-width="3"/><text x="300" y="185" fill="#7ee2a8" font-size="16">B</text></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="240" y="185" fill="#ffd479" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">A∩B</text></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="520" y="140" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="17">P(A or B) =</text><text x="520" y="170" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">P(A)+P(B)−P(A and B)</text><text x="520" y="220" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="17">Independent and:</text><text x="520" y="250" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">P(A)×P(B)</text></g><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Union vs intersection · independence matters</text></svg>

sections.heading: Choose the right denominator
sections.body: A positive test is not the same as a true positive rate among all items.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Among positive tests, choose the right denominator"><title>Among positive tests, choose the right denominator</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Among positive tests, choose the right denominator</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><g class="lw-step"><text x="80" y="120" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="16">1,000 parts · 10 defective</text></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="80" y="170" fill="#7ee2a8" font-size="16">9 true positives · 99 false positives</text></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="80" y="220" fill="#ffd479" font-size="16">108 total positives</text></g><g class="lw-step"><text x="80" y="280" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="20">9 / 108 ≈ 8.3% truly defective</text></g><rect x="480" y="110" width="250" height="180" rx="12" fill="#172331" stroke="#344253"/><text x="500" y="150" fill="#ffd479" font-size="16">Not 9/10</text><text x="500" y="190" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="14">Condition on the</text><text x="500" y="215" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="14">evidence you have</text><text x="500" y="255" fill="#7cc7ff" font-size="14">Denominator = positives</text><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Base rates change the meaning of a positive test</text></svg>
